title: Breana Tiesi Shows LaVar and Trishia Arrington a Luxury Hollywood Hills Home
htmlContent:
Breana Tiesi, one of Selling Sunset's outstanding real estate agents, takes center stage in Season 9, Episode 4, during her presentation of a stunning Hollywood Hills mansion [four bedrooms, four bathrooms on 5,350 sqft] to former NFL linebacker LaVar Arrington and his wife, Trishia Arrington. The episode showcases one of the season's most luxurious listings as well as a fascinating crossover between professional sports and luxury Los Angeles real estate. [caption id="attachment_550693" align="alignnone" width="475"] Courtesy of Big Ten Network YouTube[/caption]

LaVar Arrington and Trishia Arrington Step Into the Spotlight

LaVar Arrington, whose career includes stints with the Washington Commanders and New York Giants, has transitioned seamlessly from the gridiron to the media and business world. Joined by his wife, Trishia Arrington, a health and fitness advocate, the couple's appearance on Selling Sunset gave viewers a glimpse into their next significant chapter — exploring luxury living in California. Breana Tiesi, renowned for her high-profile clientele and effortless confidence, escorted the Arringtons through an elegant, multi-million-dollar property in the Hollywood Hills. The home's panoramic city views, modern architecture, and resort-style amenities exemplify the Oppenheim Group's representation of the Los Angeles luxury market.

Inside the Stunning Bird Streets Residence

The episode highlights a luxurious one-family masterpiece situated in the highly sought-after Bird Streets area of the Hollywood Hills, only a short walk from the world-famous Sunset Strip. The residence, originally built in 1964, has been completely redesigned with modern architectural brilliance by acclaimed designer Paul McClean, who is known for creating some of the most exclusive contemporary estates in Los Angeles. The elegance of this single-story home is evident in its 5,350 square feet of carefully designed living space, situated on a 0.294-acre lot, which seamlessly blends architectural sophistication with California's signature indoor-outdoor lifestyle.

Key highlights of the residence include:

  • Four bedrooms and four full bathrooms, each designed with comfort, privacy, and style in mind.

  • A striking courtyard entrance featuring dual water feature walls, a fire element, and integrated LED lighting, setting a dramatic tone from the moment you arrive.

  • Large-format porcelain tile floors and Venetian plaster walls and ceilings that deliver refined texture and visual harmony throughout the home.

  • A 100-year-old olive tree artfully showcased in the living room, illuminated by an LED wall and framed by floor-to-ceiling glass panels for a breathtaking visual centerpiece.

  • Cutting-edge Control4 smart home technology offering seamless control of lighting, climate, security, and entertainment systems.

  • Floor-to-ceiling Fleetwood doors and windows provide unobstructed, panoramic views of the Los Angeles skyline, Pacific Ocean, coastline, and Hollywood Hills.

  • Outdoor living spaces feature a serene fire pit, in-ground spa, and pool with stunning city views, ideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation.

  • Central heating and cooling systems ensure year-round comfort and efficiency.

  • A gourmet kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, ideal for both culinary creativity and elegant hosting.

  • Private gated access and a spacious garage with room for two vehicles, complemented by ample driveway parking.

The single-level layout of the home demonstrates flexibility between indoor and outdoor spaces, creating a living experience that is both open and intimate. An investor sold this property for approximately $ 10.25 million in early 2025; it is a rare blend of modern luxury, architectural excellence, and a prime location. The Bird Streets neighborhood's best street, where neighboring homes have sold for up to $25 million, stands as a testament to timeless design and exceptional value. Above the lights of Los Angeles, this exceptional California residence embodies the pinnacle of sophisticated design, privacy, and panoramic beauty, offering its prospective owners a refined sanctuary.

From Football Field to Luxury Real Estate: LaVar Arrington’s Post-NFL Journey

After leaving the NFL, LaVar Arrington has seamlessly transformed into one of the most dynamic sports media voices in modern history. The former Pro Bowler and No. 2 overall draft pick has cultivated a multifaceted post-football career that bridges broadcasting, entrepreneurship, and athlete development — proving that his leadership extends far beyond the gridiron. Up On Game, a national weekend show and podcast on Fox Sports Radio, is hosted by Arrington with his fellow former NFL stars TJ Houshmandzadeh and Plaxico Burress. The program, which airs live on Saturdays and streams across major digital platforms, explores sports culture and the challenges facing today's athletes in depth. Arrington leads conversations that aim to educate, empower, and inspire by using a blend of candid storytelling and solution-focused dialogue, and welcomes guests from across sports, entertainment, and business. In addition to being a respected sports commentator, Arrington also hosts the weekday morning show '2 Pros and a Cup of Joe', where millions of listeners nationwide hear his sharp insights and engaging personality.  He offers real-time analysis and unfiltered opinions on the biggest stories in sports, drawing authenticity and perspective from his decorated NFL career. Arrington is not only a broadcaster but also the CEO of The Complete Athlete, an organization dedicated to the holistic development of athletes. The company is committed to developing not only physical and mental performance but also financial literacy, entrepreneurship, and long-term success that extends beyond competition. His goal is to equip athletes with the skills they need to thrive both on and off the field by helping them navigate the business side of sports with confidence and honesty. Arrington began his media career with local radio and writing columns for The Washington Post, but eventually gained more prominence on FS1 and other major outlets. He is currently a pioneer in athlete-led media, using his platform to advocate for empowerment, education, and evolution within the sports community. His continued rise from NFL linebacker to respected broadcaster and entrepreneur reinforces a powerful message.  Discipline, resilience, and passion drive greatness on the field and can shape success in all areas of life. His appearance on Selling Sunset highlights his growing presence in mainstream media, as well as giving fans an inside look at his family life with Trishia. Breana Tiesi’s Rise in Real Estate and Reality TV

Breana Tiesi is still establishing herself as one of the top agents at the Oppenheim Group. Bre's striking presence and sharp negotiation skills have made her a fan favorite since joining the cast. One of the most sought-after agents for celebrity clients in Los Angeles is due to her background as a model and media personality, as well as her business acumen. Tiesi's clients are a testament to her ability to seamlessly blend luxury and lifestyle, from professional athletes to entertainment icons.

Fan Reactions to the Arringtons’ Appearance

After the episode's premiere, one fan took to social media to express their excitement about LaVar and Trishia Arrington's appearance. One X user shared, "ctfuuu they got LaVar Arrington on Selling Sunset  his wife is gorgeous!!" Fans of the NFL and Netflix series were both intrigued by the crossover between sports culture and reality television. [caption id="attachment_550697" align="alignnone" width="590"] Courtesy of The Oppenheim Group[/caption]

The Oppenheim Group’s Continued Expansion and Influence

Selling Sunset's ongoing mission to combine real estate glamour with cultural relevance is underscored by the Arrington episode. The Oppenheim Group, headed by Jason and Brett Oppenheim, has extended its reach beyond luxury property sales. The series continues to draw global audiences with its high-profile client interactions, celebrity features, and pop culture relevance, while also setting new standards for real estate entertainment.

A Perfect Blend of Sports, Luxury, and Lifestyle

Breana Tiesi's interaction with the Arringtons exemplifies how Selling Sunset transcends traditional reality TV formats. It's not just about real estate. It's about the stories behind the clients, the drive for success, and the dynamic personalities that shape the industry. The experience helped LaVar and Trishia Arrington navigate life beyond the NFL spotlight as a power couple. Breana's status as one of Los Angeles' elite agents, capable of blending luxury living and authentic storytelling, was reaffirmed.

Conclusion

The intersection of sports legacy, luxury real estate, and entertainment culture is depicted in The Selling Sunset Season 9 episode, which includes Breana Tiesi and LaVar Arrington. Bre and LaVar's collaboration is another iconic moment in the series' evolution, as Bre excels in her real estate career and LaVar expands his influence beyond football.
